title: continuous-batcher-scheduler-tuning-queueing-fairness-starvation-timeouts
author: Nina Patel
description: Motivation: continuous-batcher was showing unfair queueing under mixed-latency workloads which caused starvation of small, latency-sensitive requests. This PR introduces scheduler-level tuning to improve queueing fairness, add starvation prevention via aging priorities, and tighter timeouts/backpressure to avoid resource exhaustion. Changes include a new per-priority aging score, configurable max-wait thresholds with exponential backoff, KV-cache warm-up hints, and telemetry to surface scheduling latency distributions. This aims to reduce p99 tail latency for latency-sensitive traffic while preserving overall throughput. Checklist: [x] Scheduler aging score implementation; [x] Config knobs for max-wait-ms and backoff; [x] KV cache warm-up API + small warm-up worker; [x] Metric dashboards and test harness; [x] Benchmarks (see summary). Related: ENG-4321 (fairness experiments), SUP-2210 (customer incident). See inline commit summaries and reviews for implementation details.
commits: add max-wait-ms config and exponential backoff for queued requests
kv cache warmup: add warmup hints and small worker
add scheduler telemetry: per-priority latency histograms, queued-count gauges
tests: add synthetic mixed-latency scheduler e2e harness
review_comments: Liam Chen: overall approach LGTM, please add more comments around the aging score formula and ensure the cost of computing score is bounded.
Nina Patel: addressed comment, added microbench for score computation and inline comments.
Sofia Martinez: requested an adjustable cooldown when preempting batches to avoid thrashing — added 'preempt_cooldown_ms' config with default 50ms.
Arjun Gupta: noted potential interaction with autoscaler; added integration test to ensure scheduler doesn't starve when nodes scale up/down.
CI: flaky test 'test_scheduler_latency_spike' failed on first run; rerun passed after tightening synthetic timing tolerance.
merge_details: Merged by squash on 2025-01-15 by Nina Patel. Merge commit message: 'scheduler: tuning for queueing fairness and starvation prevention (ENG-4321)'.
release_notes: Improves fairness and tail latency for mixed workloads by adding aging-based priorities, configurable wait-timeouts and exponential backoff, KV cache warmup hooks, and new scheduler telemetry. Ops: see docs/ops/scheduler-tuning.md for recommended config values.
benchmark_summary: Synthetic mixed-latency benchmark: 6-12% throughput retention with 20-40% reduction in p99 latency for small/latency-sensitive requests (workloads with 10-90 mix). End-to-end e2e on staging shows no regression for bulk throughput-heavy traffic; minor CPU increase (+3%) on scheduler threads due to aging calculation.
changelog_notes: Added scheduler tuning knobs: max-wait-ms, preempt_cooldown_ms, aging_score_alpha, backoff_multiplier; KV warmup API: kv_warmup.hint(key) and a small optional worker process.
